title: Bill's Seat
overview: In the tradition of Roald Dahl or O. Henry, this strange little psychological thriller begins when a New Yorker stops in a small Pennsylvania town with a flat tire only trapped in the local bar where he is accused of being a hit and run driver who killed one of their patrons. As the locals interrogate and threaten our protagonist we are lead through a series of psychological twists and turns, leading to a very surprise ending.
